mapper.select: SELECT event_id AS eventId, application_id AS applicationId, user_id AS userId, action AS action, occurred_at_ms AS occurredAtMs, bucket_ms AS bucketMs FROM analytics_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analytics_application_bucket( application_id, bucket_ms, visits, orders, payments, claims, closed_orders ) VALUES ( #{applicationId}, #{bucketMs}, 10, 10, 10, 10, 10 ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE visits = visits + VALUES(visits), orders = orders + VALUES(orders), payments = payments + VALUES(payments), claims = claims + VALUES(claims), closed_orders = closed_orders + VALUES(closed_orders)
INSERT IGNORE INTO analytics_visit_user(application_id, user_id, bucket_ms) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{userId}, #{bucketMs})
mapper.select: SELECT b.application_id AS applicationId, a.name AS name, a.summary AS summary, a.cover_url AS coverUrl, b.visits AS visits, COALESCE(u.uv, 0) AS uv, b.orders AS orders, b.payments AS payments, b.claims AS claims, (b.visits * #{visitWeight} + COALESCE(u.uv, 0) * #{uvWeight} + b.orders * #{orderWeight} + b.payments * #{paymentWeight} + b.claims * #{claimWeight}) AS heat FROM ( SELECT application_id, SUM(visits) AS visits, SUM(orders) AS orders, SUM(payments) AS payments, SUM(claims) AS claims FROM analytics_application_bucket WHERE bucket_ms >= #{fromMs} AND bucket_ms < #{toMs} GROUP BY application_id ) b JOIN ai_application a ON a.id = b.application_id AND a.status = 1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT application_id, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS uv FROM analytics_visit_user WHERE bucket_ms >= #{fromMs} AND bucket_ms < #{toMs} GROUP BY application_id ) u ON u.application_id = b.application_id ORDER BY heat DESC, b.application_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT SUM(visits) AS visits, SUM(orders) AS orders, SUM(payments) AS payments, SUM(claims) AS claims, SUM(closed_orders) AS closedOrders FROM analytics_application_bucket WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND bucket_ms >= #{fromMs} AND bucket_ms < #{toMs}
SELECT name FROM ai_application WHERE id = #{applicationId} AND status = 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM analytics_event WHERE occurred_at_ms < #{cutoffMs} LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE FROM analytics_visit_user WHERE bucket_ms < #{cutoffMs} LIMIT #{limit}
DELETE FROM analytics_application_bucket WHERE bucket_ms < #{cutoffMs} LIMIT #{limit}
